English Grammar: Prepositions (Notes & Tricks)

Preposition kya hota hai?

Preposition (Pre + Position) aise words hote hain jo kisi Noun ya Pronoun se pehle aakar uska relation sentence ke doosre shabdon ke sath batate hain (jaise: time, place, direction, ya location).

🔥 Golden Tricks (Important Rules) - Part 1

1. Trick for Time (At, On, In):
• At: Exact / Fix time ke liye (At 5 PM, At night).
• On: Days aur Dates ke liye (On Monday, On 15th August).
• In: Lambe samay jaise Months, Years, Seasons ke liye (In January, In 2026, In summer).

Example Trick: I will meet you in December, on Monday, at 5 PM.

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 2

2. Trick for Place (At vs In):
• At: Chhoti jagah (colony, village, specific location) ke liye.
• In: Badi jagah (city, state, country, enclosed space) ke liye.

Example Trick: He lives at Andheri in Mumbai. (Pehle chhoti jagah, phir badi jagah)

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 3

3. Trick for Position vs Movement (In/On vs Into/Onto):
• In / On: Jab koi cheez pehle se rest position (bina hile) andar ya upar ho.
• Into / Onto: Jab koi cheez motion (gati/harkat) mein aakar andar ya upar jaye.

Examples:
• The cat is on the table. (Pehle se baithi hai)
• The cat jumped onto the table. (Kood kar upar aayi)

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 4

4. The '2 vs More' Rule (Between vs Among):
• Between: Sirf 2 logon ya cheezon ke beech ke liye.
• Among: 2 se zyada logon ya group ke beech ke liye.

Example: Distribute this cake between Ram and Shyam, and share the sweets among all the students.

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 5

5. The 'Doer vs Tool' Rule (By vs With):
• By: Jab koi kaam kisi Insaan (living being) ke dwara kiya jaye.
• With: Jab koi kaam kisi Auzaar (tool/non-living object) ka use karke kiya jaye.

Example: The tiger was killed by the hunter with a gun.

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 6

6. Time Duration (Since vs For):
• Since: Fix/Starting point ke liye (Since 2018, Since morning, Since Monday).
• For: Ginti (Duration/Period) wale samay ke liye (For 2 hours, For 5 months).

Example: She has been studying since morning, which means she has studied for 4 hours.

🔥 Golden Tricks - Part 7

7. Above vs Over (Upar):
• Above: Level batane ke liye (jab physical touch na ho aur direct upar hona zaroori nahi).
• Over: Jab koi cheez theek upar ho aur usne cover kiya ho, ya movement dikhani ho.

Example: The fan is running over my head. The plane is flying above the clouds.
